items.title: Scrabble episode, late 1988-A (USA rerun 9/16/94)
items.description:
Bonus jackpot of $9,000. First contestants are Lisa Stevenson and Tony Cavaliu. Second contestants: Cynthia Zigraft, and John West. Chuck Woolery hosts, and he ends up doing a blooper! Taped off a USA Network rerun on 9/16/94 with commercials.

(C)1988 Reg Grundy Productions.

items.title: Scrabble episode, late 1988-B (USA rerun 9/20/1994)
items.description:
1988 episode - Bonus jackpot $8,000. First contestants are: Barb Fisher and Steve Demmer (sp?). Second contestants: Melissa Hassburger, and Nolan Bersard. Taped from a USA repeat on 9/20/1994 with commercials. Chuck Woolery hosts.

(C)1988 Reg Grundy Productions.
